title: Prompt-Assembly & Persona-Delivery Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for how a Molecule workspace's system prompt is ASSEMBLED and how a persona / identity is DELIVERED. Sibling of ../mcp/mcp-plugin-delivery.schema.json: where THAT contract pins how the management-MCP descriptor is delivered into each runtime's native config (the runtime's TOOLS), THIS contract pins the ordered layers the shared engine composes into config.system_prompt (the runtime's PROMPT) and the composition-based, concierge-only convention by which a concierge's IDENTITY rides as an always-on management-plugin rule. Typed from molecule-ai-workspace-runtime: molecule_runtime.prompt.build_system_prompt (assembly order + BASE_PLATFORM_PROMPT + ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY_GUARDRAIL + the mcp_server_present-gated concierge-only guardrail), molecule_runtime.persona_render (_RUNTIME_PERSONA native identity files + read_canonical_persona + materialize_persona_for), and molecule_runtime.plugins (rules/*.md -> plugin.rules; *.md -> prompt_fragments). This schema does NOT re-declare the per-runtime persona MATERIALIZATION metadata — that is owned by ../adapter/official-runtimes.registry.json (each runtime's `persona` block) and the adapter socket method `materialize_persona` in ../adapter/adapter-socket.contract.md §4; this contract REFERENCES them and remains the SSOT for the ASSEMBLY ORDER, the canonical base/guardrail TEXT, and the persona-DELIVERY convention. Nothing here is invented — every field is derived from the current working engine.

producer.description: The single assembler that composes the ordered layers into config.system_prompt (e.g. molecule_runtime.prompt.build_system_prompt, driven by BaseAdapter._common_setup).

consumer.description: Primary consumer of the assembled prompt (e.g. the active runtime executor via config.system_prompt).

consumers.description: Full list of consumers/derivers of the assembled prompt and/or the delivered persona.

assembly_order.description: The ORDERED prompt-assembly layers, exactly as build_system_prompt appends them. Position in the array IS the layer order (first element = top of prompt). Each entry names one layer, whether it is gated, and what sources it. This ordering is the SSOT: the engine must consume it from here rather than hardcoding the sequence.

layer.description: Stable identifier for the assembly layer (e.g. base_frame, orchestrator_guardrail, platform_instructions, capabilities_preamble, prompt_files, memory_snapshots, plugin_rules, plugin_prompts, skills, platform_tool_instructions, peers, delegation_failure_handling).

source.description: Where this layer's content comes from (a canonical_text key, a build_system_prompt parameter, a runtime-generated helper, or an on-disk convention).

gated.description: Whether this layer is conditionally injected (true) or always present (false).

gate.description: For a gated layer: the condition under which it is injected (e.g. 'platform_guardrail (== mcp_server_present())', 'platform_instructions non-empty', 'a2a_mcp'). Absent for ungated layers.

heading.description: The literal markdown heading the assembler prepends for this layer, when it emits one (e.g. '# Platform Instructions', '## Platform Rules', '## Your Skills'). Absent when the layer emits raw content with no synthetic heading.

canonical_text.description: The canonical SSOT TEXT for the engine-owned prompt layers that today are hardcoded string constants in molecule_runtime.prompt. The engine should consume these from the contract rather than embedding them. Each entry pins the constant's runtime symbol name and its verbatim text.

symbol.description: Runtime symbol that today holds this text (molecule_runtime.prompt.BASE_PLATFORM_PROMPT).

always_first.description: INVARIANT — the base frame is prepended to EVERY workspace's prompt, first, regardless of runtime or template. Pinned true.

symbol.description: Runtime symbol that today holds this text (molecule_runtime.prompt.ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY_GUARDRAIL).

concierge_only.description: INVARIANT — injected ONLY for platform/concierge agents; a normal worker workspace MUST NOT receive it (workers must keep doing real work). Pinned true.

gate.description: The runtime-side signal that gates injection (platform_guardrail, wired == mcp_server_present()).

position.description: Where it is injected relative to other layers (immediately after the base frame, ahead of platform_instructions and the possibly-stale prompt_files), worded to override any later 'do the work yourself' text.

concierge_guardrail_gate.description: The gate that decides whether the orchestrator-only guardrail is injected. This is the runtime-side platform-ness signal — the SAME signal the MCP delivery contract's degrade gate keys on — reconciled here as the guardrail gate.

signal.description: The boolean predicate that gates the guardrail (mcp_server_present()).

call_site.description: Where the gate is evaluated and passed into build_system_prompt (BaseAdapter._common_setup, platform_guardrail=is_platform_agent).

default_on_error.description: INVARIANT — a predicate error must NEVER gag a worker nor crash boot: default to worker (no guardrail). Pinned false (== not a platform agent).

persona_delivery.description: The persona-DELIVERY convention (this contract's own SSOT, distinct from per-runtime MATERIALIZATION): a concierge's identity is delivered as an always-on plugin RULE from the privileged management plugin — composition-based, concierge-only, runtime-agnostic. NO per-template system-prompt.md and NO `if kind == platform` branch.

mechanism.description: How the identity is delivered (an always-on rules/*.md that auto-globs into plugin.rules and folds into build_system_prompt via plugin_rules=..., landing in the '## Platform Rules' layer).

delivery_plugin.description: The privileged, concierge-only plugin that carries the identity rule (molecule-platform-mcp).

rule_file.description: The rule file inside the delivery plugin that holds the concierge identity (rules/concierge-identity.md).

assembly_layer.description: Which assembly_order layer the delivered rule lands in (plugin_rules, under the '## Platform Rules' heading).

composition_based.description: INVARIANT — identity is COMPOSED in via a plugin rule, not baked per-template. Pinned true.

concierge_only.description: INVARIANT — the identity rides only on the privileged management plugin, which is installable ONLY on the org-root kind=platform concierge; a worker never receives it. Pinned true.

runtime_agnostic.description: INVARIANT — the rule is plain markdown folded by the runtime-agnostic assembler; no per-runtime persona branch is needed for the concierge identity. Pinned true.

no_per_template_system_prompt.description: INVARIANT — the concierge identity is NOT delivered via a per-template system-prompt.md (the pre-fix per-template-drift class). Pinned true.

no_kind_branch.description: INVARIANT — no `if kind == platform` special-case in the assembler; the concierge-only-ness comes from the plugin's install scope, not a code branch. Pinned true.

persona_materialization_ref.description: REFERENCE (not a re-declaration) to where the per-runtime persona MATERIALIZATION is owned. The concierge identity delivered as a plugin rule (persona_delivery) reaches the model via the assembled prompt; a runtime whose CLI reads a NATIVE identity file instead receives the same canonical persona through materialize_persona. Both are owned elsewhere; this contract points at them.

registry_ref.description: The SSOT for per-runtime native identity files (../adapter/official-runtimes.registry.json, each runtime's `persona` block: native_identity_file, materializer, status).

socket_method_ref.description: The adapter-socket method that writes the canonical persona into a runtime's native identity file (../adapter/adapter-socket.contract.md §4, materialize_persona).

canonical_reader.description: The runtime-agnostic reader that sources the canonical persona from prompt_files (molecule_runtime.persona_render.read_canonical_persona, fallback system-prompt.md).

delivery_vs_materialization.description: Prose stating the seam: THIS contract owns prompt ASSEMBLY + the persona-DELIVERY convention; the registry + socket own per-runtime persona MATERIALIZATION; the disjunction (executor surfaces config.system_prompt XOR materialize_persona writes the native file) is owned by the socket contract §2/§4.

runtimes.description: Per-runtime persona native-identity-file view, RECONCILED with ../adapter/official-runtimes.registry.json's persona blocks (same runtimes, same native_identity_file, same materializer). Runtime keys are the underscore dispatch spelling (mcp_render.normalize_runtime). This block is the adapter-DELIVERY-facing mirror; the registry remains SSOT for the persona materialization metadata.

native_identity_file.description: The runtime's native identity file the canonical persona is materialized into (may be `unverified` for a fail-loud-stub runtime).

cleared_placeholder_files.description: Baked generic placeholder files this runtime's materializer clears so they can't compete with the materialized identity (e.g. openclaw clears BOOTSTRAP.md / AGENTS.md).

materializer.description: The adapter method that writes the native identity file (e.g. OpenClawAdapter.materialize_persona). ADR-004: owned by the template's adapter, not a shared-engine function.

status.description: Materialization status for this runtime (e.g. implemented, fail-loud-stub).
